complex.explanation: Keluhan lampau berulang 'was always + V-ing'.
hints: Adverb of frequency berada SEBELUM verb utama ('She always arrives early'), namun SETELAH 'to be' ('She is always punctual').
Dengan modal/auxiliary, adverb berada di tengah ('must always check', 'doesn't usually stay', 'have rarely seen').
